name: forward_packets
description: Packets matching the first packet direction.

name: backward_packets
description: Packets opposite the first packet direction.

name: forward_bytes
description: IP-layer bytes in the forward direction.

name: backward_bytes
description: IP-layer bytes in the backward direction.

name: packets_per_second
description: Total packet rate over flow duration.
calculation: total_packets / duration; zero when duration is zero

name: bytes_per_second
description: Total IP-layer byte rate over flow duration.
calculation: total_bytes / duration; zero when duration is zero

name: forward_backward_packet_ratio
description: Forward packets divided by backward packets.
calculation: forward_packets / backward_packets; zero when backward is zero

name: forward_backward_byte_ratio
description: Forward bytes divided by backward bytes.
calculation: forward_bytes / backward_bytes; zero when backward is zero

name: std_packet_size
description: Population standard deviation of IP packet sizes.

name: backward_mean_packet_size
calculation: backward arithmetic mean; zero when absent

name: flow_duration
description: Seconds between earliest and latest packet.

name: mean_inter_arrival_time
description: Mean non-negative inter-arrival time in seconds.

name: std_inter_arrival_time
description: Population standard deviation of inter-arrival times.

name: forward_mean_iat
description: Mean inter-arrival time among forward packets.

name: backward_mean_iat
description: Mean inter-arrival time among backward packets.
calculation: mean adjacent sorted backward timestamps; zero when unavailable

name: syn_ratio
description: Fraction of packets with SYN set.

name: rst_ratio
description: Fraction of packets with RST set.

name: ack_ratio
description: Fraction of packets with ACK set.

name: completed_handshake_indicator
description: Observed SYN, reverse SYN+ACK, then forward ACK in capture order.
calculation: bounded evidence indicator; not a full TCP state-machine proof

name: connection_burst_score
description: Largest share of packets observed in any one-second window.

name: periodicity_score
description: Regularity proxy from inter-arrival coefficient of variation.
calculation: 1 / (1 + IAT coefficient of variation); zero with fewer than three IATs

name: failed_connection_indicator
description: TCP reset or incomplete SYN evidence indicator.
calculation: 1 when TCP has RST, or SYN without the bounded handshake indicator
